title: Universal NP-Hardness of Clustering under General Utilities
abstract: arXiv:2603.00210v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Clustering is a central primitive in unsupervised learning, yet practice is dominated by heuristics whose outputs can be unstable and highly sensitive to representations, hyperparameters, and initialisation. Existing theoretical results are largely objective-specific and do not explain these behaviours at a unifying level. We formalise the common optimisation core underlying diverse clustering paradigms by defining the Universal Clustering Problem (UCP): the maximisation of a polynomial-time computable partition utility over a finite metric space. We prove the NP-hardness of UCP via two independent polynomial-time reductions from graph colouring and from exact cover by 3-sets (X3C). By mapping ten major paradigms -- including k-means, GMMs, DBSCAN, spectral clustering, and affinity propagation -- to the UCP framework, we demonstrate that each inherits this fundamental intractability. translated_title: 一般效用函数下聚类问题的普遍NP难性
translated_abstract: 聚类是无监督学习中的核心方法，然而实践中主要依赖启发式算法，其输出往往不稳定，且对数据表示、超参数和初始化高度敏感。现有理论结果大多局限于特定目标函数，无法在统一层面解释这些现象。我们通过定义通用聚类问题（UCP）——即在有限度量空间上最大化多项式时间可计算的划分效用函数——形式化了多种聚类范式背后共同的优化核心。我们通过两次独立的多项式时间归约（分别源于图着色问题和三元素精确覆盖问题X3C）证明了UCP的NP难性。通过将十种主要聚类范式——包括k-means、高斯混合模型（GMM）、DBSCAN、谱聚类和亲和传播算法——映射到UCP框架中，我们证明了每一种范式都继承了这种根本性的计算难解性。我们的结果为这些现象提供了统一的解释……
tldr: 该论文定义了通用聚类问题（UCP），并通过图着色和X3C问题的多项式时间归约证明了其NP难性，从而统一揭示了包括k-means、DBSCAN、谱聚类等十种主流聚类范式在一般效用函数下均具有根本性的计算难解性。
en_tdlr: This paper defines the Universal Clustering Problem (UCP) and proves its NP-hardness via polynomial-time reductions from graph coloring and X3C, thereby unifying the demonstration that ten major clustering paradigms—including k-means, DBSCAN, and spectral clustering—inherit this fundamental computational intractability under general utilities.
